THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

All that Allotment of land described as following name and extent depicted in the Advance Tracing No. CO/MHR/2019/202 dated 14.05.2019 of the Surveyor General, situated at the village called Pannipitiya (within Maharagama Urban Council limits), in Maharagama Town Grama Niladhari Division, No. 530, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Maharagama of Colombo District Western Province and bounded as follows. :
01. Lot ‘A’ – Land at Railway Avenue of which the assessment number cannot be found - Extent: 0.0102 Hectare
North: Land at Railway Avenue of which the assessment number cannot be found which is claimed by the SANASA

establishment; East: Land bearing assessment No. 211 and 211/1 at Railway Avenue which is claimed W.L.D.S. Perera; South: Railway Avenue and Land at Railway Avenue of which the assessment number cannot be found which is claimed by the SANASA establishment; West: Land at Railway Avenue of which the assessment number cannot be found which is claimed by the SANASA establishment.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My No.: 4-3/9/2018/WS/224.Ministry of Tourism and Lands“Mihikatha Medura”, No. 1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla,01st February, 2024.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

All that allotment of land described as following name and extent depicted in the Advance Tracing No. CO/MHR/2019/200 and dated 14.05.2019, of the Surveyor General, situated at the village of Pannipitiya (within Maharagama Urban Council limits) in Maharagama Town Grama Niladhari Division, No. 530 in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Maharagama in Colombo District Western Province and bounded as follows. :
01. Lot ‘A’ – Assessment No. 401/1 High Level Road - Extent: 0.0102 Hectare
North: Land bearing assessment No. 401/1 High Level Road which is claimed by P.N.F. Perera and others; East: Land

bearing assessment No. 401/1 High Level Road which claimed by P.N.F. Perera and others; South: High Level Road and land bearing assessment No. 373/1 at High Level Road which is claimed by P. Gunawathi; West: land bearing assessment No. 373/1 at High Level Road which is claimed by P. Gunawathi.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
